2026–2027 Texas Energy, CLE & Regulatory Calendar

Texas Oil & Gas Landman, Mineral Law & RRC Hearings Calendar

Key dates for Texas Railroad Commission rulemakings, NAPE Summit Houston, UT Ernest E. Smith Oil & Gas Law Institute, PBLA Midland, HAPL/FWAPL/DAPL seminars, TLTA, and AAPL continuing education.

November 20, 2026 Regulatory Hearing · Austin, TX & Zoom Webinar

Railroad Commission of Texas — Public Hearing on SB 1150 Inactive-Well Rules (16 TAC §§ 3.15 & 3.58)

Why It Matters to Landmen: Directly governs W-3X plugging extensions, surface-equipment removal certifications, and P-5 operator compliance on inactive Texas wells — critical for HBP lease-termination and top-leasing title analysis.

Organizer: Railroad Commission of Texas · Official Event / Agency Portal →
December 2026 (Scheduled Open Meeting) Regulatory Hearing · William B. Travis Bldg · Austin, TX

Texas RRC December Commissioners Open Meeting (Public Comment Period Reinstated)

Why It Matters to Landmen: First open Commissioners meeting restoring public comment following the August–November 2026 suspension; covers contested Oil & Gas dockets, Rule 37/38 exceptions, MIPA pooling, and enforcement orders.

Organizer: Railroad Commission of Texas · Official Event / Agency Portal →
January 2027 · Midland, TX Landman Association · Midland, TX

Permian Basin Landmen's Association (PBLA) — Winter Educational Seminar & Midland Networking

Why It Matters to Landmen: AAPL continuing-education credits focused on Midland & Delaware Basin horizontal allocation/PSA wells, New Mexico/Texas state-line unitization, and courthouse digitization workflows.

Organizer: Permian Basin Landmen's Association (PBLA) · Official Event / Agency Portal →
February 3 – 5, 2027 Deal Expo & Conference · George R. Brown Convention Center · Houston, TX

NAPE Summit 2027 — Global Energy Prospect, A&D & Landman Expo

Why It Matters to Landmen: Flagship Texas deal-making floor for upstream A&D packages, non-op working interests, mineral/royalty funds, and live side-by-side vendor evaluations of AI title and landman software.

Organizer: NAPE (AAPL · IPAA · SEG · AAPG) · Official Event / Agency Portal →
Spring 2027 · Houston, TX CLE & Mineral Law · Houston, TX

53rd Annual Ernest E. Smith Oil, Gas and Mineral Law Institute

Why It Matters to Landmen: Premier annual Texas Supreme Court mineral-title case-law review (covering post-Clifton v. Johnson double-fraction litigation, Fasken v. Puig postproduction deductions, pooling/allocation wells, and pore-space/lithium severances).

Organizer: UT Law CLE & State Bar of Texas Oil, Gas & Energy Resources Law Section · Official Event / Agency Portal →
April 2027 · Houston · Fort Worth · Dallas Landman Association · Houston, Fort Worth & Dallas, TX

Texas Metro Landman Associations — HAPL, FWAPL & DAPL Spring Land & Title Seminars

Why It Matters to Landmen: CPL/RPL recertification ethics and title examination workshops covering Haynesville gas resurgence, Barnett re-completions, and AI verification ethics in brokerage deliverables.

Organizer: HAPL · FWAPL · DAPL · Official Event / Agency Portal →
June 2027 CLE & Mineral Law · Texas (Statewide)

Texas Land Title Association (TLTA) Annual Conference & Business Meeting

Why It Matters to Landmen: Covers Texas county clerk e-recording standards, SB 16 real-property fraud implementation, geographic title-plant licensing, and surface/mineral severance exceptions.

Organizer: Texas Land Title Association · Official Event / Agency Portal →
June 2027 Deal Expo & Conference · National / Texas Delegation

AAPL Annual Meeting 2027 — American Association of Professional Landmen

Why It Matters to Landmen: National CPL/RPL/RL curriculum updates, AAPL Standards of Practice reviews on AI-assisted title runsheets, and Affinity Vendor technology showcases.

Organizer: American Association of Professional Landmen (Fort Worth, TX HQ) · Official Event / Agency Portal →
